tasks.short: Select an appropriate mill, arrange haulage and separately record and send the booking.

steps.what: Retrieve available logs, destination requirements and existing haulage information
Discuss mill acceptance, access and haulage availability with the relevant contacts
Choose the appropriate mill site and workable hauling arrangement
Write the haulage booking with load, pickup and mill destination details
Check the final booking and send the hauling request to the haulier
Record booking confirmations and resolve missing or changed haulage details

tasks.design: Configure load-linked destination and booking forms in {OPS_SYSTEM}, using current mill references in {DOCS}. Availability discussion, destination judgement, booking entry, the actual request through {EMAIL} and later confirmation entry remain separate steps.
tasks.previous_blocker: Load and destination identifiers are repeatedly found and copied into bookings.
tasks.enabler_now: Native load records and booking defaults can reuse stable information.
tasks.still_hard: Changing mill acceptance, access conditions and haulier availability.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiating a workable arrangement and recognising unsuitable destinations.
tasks.altitude: Coordinate hauling from a clearer load record with less repeated entry.

evidence.claim: PONSSE Manager produces load certificates with load volume; this supports load-record availability, not a haulage scheduling benefit.
Native booking defaults and linked mill references may reduce handling; labour benefit is E1.

assumptions: The task includes the booking write, actual external request and confirmation entry as well as destination selection.

Existing load records supply load identity and specifications in s1. The grader captures destination identity, pickup location, contact and availability in s2-s4, and confirmation status in s6. Missing addresses or acceptance details require manual verification with effort retained.
Native booking forms precede custom software. No automatic route choice, send or promised acceptance feed is assumed.
Ordinary author saves are retained without self-approval; only the actual haulier send has a final-version gate.
unknowns: Load record completeness and native booking features
Actual frequency of changing destination instructions
research_questions: Do native defaults reduce booking entry after manual acceptance and address checks?

incremental.description: Maintain destination references and booking defaults

approvals.approved_version: Exact load, pickup location, destination, timing, haulier recipient and booking text checked before sending; any change voids approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R89 gives11 gross minus2 upkeep =9 net. Low: mill references use inconsistent identifiers and every pickup needs bespoke text, leaving retrieval15, booking19 and confirmation9 plus55 unchanged, R98; net0. High: load and destination identifiers fit but acceptance notes remain manual, leaving13+17+8+55=93 retained; net5 after2 upkeep. Discussion, destination choice and actual request remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Weigh loaded and unloaded trucks, calculate net weight and maintain the supplier-linked record.

steps.what: Identify the truck, load and supplier before weighing
Weigh the truck before unloading and capture the loaded weight
Weigh the truck after unloading and capture the unloaded weight
Calculate load weights from the matched loaded and unloaded readings
Record load weights and supplier identities in the load register
Check load matching, weight units and anomalous readings against the source tickets
outputs: checked weight record or unresolved discrepancy

tasks.design: Configure matched weigh-in and weigh-out fields with native net-weight arithmetic in {OPS_SYSTEM}, using {OTHER}, the existing weighbridge. Keep physical weighing and capture intact; replace repeated manual subtraction and reduce register re-entry while retaining the final factual check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate weigh tickets can require manual subtraction and repeated supplier and load entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native paired-weight fields and deterministic arithmetic can reuse captured readings.
tasks.still_hard: Correct truck matching, trustworthy readings and supplier identity exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing an incorrect truck or questionable physical weighing condition.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time copying and subtracting weights and more on matching and exceptions.

evidence.claim: Paired-weight arithmetic and native load forms are plausible E1 capabilities; the digest does not document this weighbridge labour result.

assumptions: The baseline is a site that manually pairs tickets and calculates net weights; if the existing weighbridge already performs this with no human calculation, s4 has no eligible labour benefit and the baseline must be remeasured.

The grader captures truck registration, load reference and supplier identity in s1. The existing weighbridge produces readings; the grader captures gross or tare value, unit, timestamp and load reference in s2-s3, with all capture time retained.
S4 uses only the two captured readings for the same load and unit. Missing or mismatched pairs require manual reconciliation, not an inferred value.
Native configuration precedes custom integration. Existing weighbridge runtime earns no saving, and ordinary author saves in s5 remain fully retained without self-approval.
unknowns: Existing weighbridge calculation and capture features
Current manual pairing and register-entry effort
Availability of stable supplier and load identifiers
research_questions: Is there actual manual subtraction or second-entry work after weighing, and can native paired fields remove it without extra capture?

already_counted.description: Physical weighing, capture and final discrepancy checks

incremental.description: Maintain weight field mapping and investigate interface exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central E1 B100 R74.5 gives25.5 gross minus3 upkeep =22.5 net. High: paired units are compatible but supplier exceptions remain, leaving identity13, calculation4 and entry21 plus45 unchanged, R83; net14 after3 upkeep. Weighing and captured readings stay full.

tasks.short: Observe log movement, choose an appropriate signal and communicate directly with coworkers.

steps.what: Observe log positions, coworkers and the current movement conditions
Determine the appropriate direction and signal for the observed movement
Check the current situation and communicate by signals to direct log movement
outputs: communicated movement signal and observed response

tasks.design: Retain live observation, situational judgement and direct signaling. A native {DOCS} reference or template can support training but cannot replace these physical communication actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The signal depends on current physical movement and coworker response.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change removes the live signaling effort.
tasks.still_hard: Rapidly changing movement conditions and whether coworkers have understood.
tasks.altitude: Protect attention for live movement coordination.

evidence.claim: A record template or native view cannot perform live physical signaling; zero gain is an E1 judgement.

assumptions: The task describes live signaling and feedback, with no required record write or lookup. No paperwork is hidden inside the in-person steps or invented to create savings.
The grader directly observes the situation in s1 and selects the signal in s2; no structured safe-to-move flag or unattended machine action is assumed.
Native views and templates are considered but do not touch the baseline live signaling work.
No system change is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Any separately required movement record in local practice
research_questions: Does observation reveal an actual lookup or record step within this task that requires separate timing?

approvals.approved_version: Exact selected signal and intended coworker checked against the current movement before communication; changed conditions require a fresh check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, zero upkeep and no new saving. Observation, signal selection and live communication remain fully retained; native templates do not remove any measured record work here.

role.altitude: Keep physical log movement accountable while reducing repeated haulage and weight-record handling.
role.ambitious_version: A grader and scaler with clearer logistics records and protected attention for live site coordination.
